name: fix-luck-imp
about: Party Luck on the imp's room (mods/hwplib-luck/scripts/HWP/Core/LuckFloors.as, HWPLuckChanceSpawn). Every theme's "*_imp" prefab set runs at exec-chance 0.1; with `hwp luck 500` (factor 6) the crypt mission's first floor (temple theme) rolls temple_imp at 60 %.

steps.name: the imp sets were swapped for the Luck one

steps.pattern: \[HWP:luck\] chance set temple_imp on \S+: party Luck 500, chance 60% \(10% vanilla\): (rolled|not rolled), placed \d+
steps.name: the imp's room rolled at 60 %
